name: Altamura (Italy)
description: Quartered white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Altamura (quartered red and white) with the motto FEDERICUS ME REPARAVIT on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Altamura, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Altamura arms — quartered red and white, crowned, with motto FEDERICUS ME REPARAVIT
